The '''Chambers of Persuasion''', also known as the '''Inquisition Chambers''', were chambers within the [[XoXaan's Temple|Temple]] of the [[One Sith]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]].

==Overview==
Located within the depths of the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[XoXaan]]'s [[XoXaan's Temple|Temple]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], the Chambers of Persuasion was a [[Torture/Legends|torture]] facility used by high-ranking members of the [[One Sith]]. In [[137 ABY]] [[Darth Havok]], a [[Sith Inquisitor]], imprisoned the captured [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Marasiah Fel]] of the [[Fel Empire]] and interrogated her within the chambers.<ref name="L49" /> The [[Imperial Knight]] [[Antares Draco]] disguised himself as a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] and infiltrated the Temple alongside fellow Knight [[Ganner Krieg]] and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Shado Vao]] in an attempt to rescue the Princess.<ref name="L50">[[Legacy (2006) 50|''Legacy'' (2006) 50]]</ref>
